model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange stays quiet on Little Hill. The four-way pact stands for us: no first strike through t=450, one full public turn of notice before any stance change, self-defence immediate. Our single rider, now around (648,566), is a fixed observation post south of z=600. It watches and holds fire.

private_messages.GPT: Thanks for the White sighting. From the south, no Blue or White units are visible below z=600 or anywhere near Little Hill. I've moved my rider back a little to around (648,566), still south of our line. It is a fixed post and holds fire. Revisiting z=600 around t=425 is agreed. If your Eye gets a count of White's main body on the crest, or sees Blue leave the West Plateau, I'd value it.
private_messages.Gemini: Thanks, noted: around t=300-325 you step east into x=440-500, z=640-720, staying north of z=620, and you announce it first. We stay on Little Hill and the southern lowland, so our armies have no reason to meet. Have your scouts seen White's main body on the Central Heights? We watch the centre from the south and are happy to trade sightings.
private_messages.Grok: Noted and matched: you keep the crest, then come down due south through x=520-660 from the north. Until the ring forces everyone in, our army stays south of the centre line, on Little Hill and the southern lowland. Our rider watches the centre from the south and will not go up toward the Heights. Happy to trade sightings: have you seen Blue's army on the West Plateau?

Pact: no 1st strike to t450, then 1 public turn notice. z600 line w/ GPT (me S), revisit ~t425. Rider nudged to (648,566). Gemini: W plateau -> x440-500 z640-720 (N of z620) ~t300-325. Plan: quiet south; let N/W armies collide w/ GPT; then hit its rear from S. Never ally. Vs archers: far or very close. Ring: t300 r420; t450 r220; then -0.87/s to r90 @t600. Leave hill T18 (t425) via N exit ~(580,510) to S lowland z540-590. ~t325 rider W to ~(530,590) to see Gemini.
parsed.explanation: A quiet turn: Orange keeps its army on the defensible Little Hill and moves its lone rider a few metres back. The rider still watches Green's archer-heavy centre army from south of the agreed z=600 line. All stances stay neutral. Orange reaffirms the pact, offers Blue and White sighting trades, and keeps its full count of Green's army as a bargaining chip for the endgame.
